bibl.title: The Gold Foundation Deposit Plaque of Ptolemy IV from the Temple of Aphrodite Ourania at Koussai.
bibl.seg: Kyriakos Savvopoulos, The Gold Foundation Deposit Plaque of Ptolemy IV from the Temple of Aphrodite Ourania at Koussai.
bibl.note: Athens, now in a private collection. The plaque had been observed in the antiquities market of Alexandria and Cairo about 1930; see: Evaristo Breccia, Note epigrafiche, BSRAA 26 (1931) p. 276, No. 1 (= S.B. V, 7782; S.E.G. VIII, 360).
